run_make_supervised_dpr_dataset: run the script to generate supervised DPR training data from input JSON with span extraction
run_make_supervised_dpr_dataset_chunk: run the script with --target chunk to extract full passage chunks as training targets
run_make_supervised_dpr_dataset_title: run the script with --target title to extract passage titles as training targets
run_make_supervised_dpr_dataset_code: run the script with --target code and --id2code to extract code passages as training targets
run_make_supervised_dpr_dataset_mark_sil: run the script with --mark_silver to label silver passages with || ? and gold with || +
